चल् {vI.v} {c1c} P. (चलति, rarely चलते,
चचाल, अचालीत्, चलितुं, चलित)
1 To shake, tremble, move, throb,
palpitate, stir; छिन्नाश्चेलुः क्षणं भुजाः

; सपक्षोद्रिरिवाचालीत्
15. 24; 6. 84.
--2 (a) To go, move on,
walk, stir or move (from one's place);
पदात्पदमपि चलितुं न शक्नोति

. (b) To proceed
(on one's way), depart, set out,
start off; चेलुश्चीरपरिग्रहाः

vl.
--3 To be affected, to be disturbed,
confused or disordered (as mind),
be agitated or perturbed; मुनेरपि
यतस्तस्य दर्शनाच्चलते मनः

.
--4 To
deviate or swerve (with abl.);
चलति नयान्न जिगीषतां हि चेतः

. --Caus. (च-चा-लयति, चलित,
चालित)
1 To cause to move, shake,
stir;

.
--2 To drive away,
dismiss, remove or expel from;
चाणक्ये चलिताधिकारविमुखे

.
--3 To lead away from.
--4 To cherish,
foster (चालयति only).
--5 To
disturb, agitate; सुजनं जनाश्चलयितुं क
ईशते Śi. 15. 40. {vII.v} {c6c} P. (चलति,
चलित) To sport, play, frolic about.

चल a. [चल्-अच्]
1 (a) Moving,^1
trembling, shaking, tremulous,
rolling (as eyes &c); चलापांगां दृष्टिं
स्पृशसि Ś. 1. 24
चलकाकपक्षकैरमात्यपुत्रैः

.
(b) Moveable (opp. स्थिर),
moving; चले लक्ष्ये Ś. 2. 5; परिचयं
चललक्ष्यनिपातने

.
--2 Unsteady,
fickle, inconstant, loose, unfixed:
दयितास्वनवस्थितं नृणां न खलु प्रेम चलं
सुहृज्जने

; प्रायश्चलं
गौरवमाश्रितषु 3. 1.
--3 Frail, transitory,
perishable; चला लक्ष्मीश्चलाः प्राणाश्चलं
जीवितयौवनं

.
--4 Confused.
--लः
1 Trembling, shaking, agitation.
--2
Wind.
--3 Quicksilver.
--4 The
supreme being.
--ला
1 Lakṣmī, the
goddess of wealth.
--2 Lightning.
--3
A kind of perfume.
--Comp.
--अचल
a. {1} moveable and immovable. {2}
fickle, unsteady, very transitory
(= अतिचल); चलाचले च संसारे धर्म
एको हि निश्चलः

(चलाचल = चंचला
Malli.); कस्य न भवति चलाचलं धनं

.
--(लः) a crow.
--आतंकः rheumatism.
--आत्मन् a.
inconstant, fickle-minded.
--इंद्रिय
a. {1} sensitive. {2} sensual.
--इषुः
one whose arrow flies unsteadily or
misses the mark, a bad archer.
--कर्णः the true distance of a planet
from the earth.
--चंचुः the Cakora
bird.
--चित्त a. fickle-minded.
--दलः, --पत्रः the Aśvattha tree.
--संधिः
moveable articulation of the bones.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20240126. note: Added comma for clarity. Rest are separated by comma. Here, it was only a line break..

चलन a. [चल् भावे ल्युट्] Moving,
tremulous, trembling, shaking.
--नः
1 A foot.
--2 A deer.
--नं
1
Trembling, shaking or shaking motion;
चलनात्मकं कर्म T. S.; हस्त˚, जानु˚
&c.;
तरलदृगंचलचलनमनोहरवदनजनितरतिरागं

.
--2 Turning or
leaving off.
--3 Roaming, wandering.
--नी
1 A short petticoat worn by
common women.
--2 The rope for
tying an elephant.

चलनकं [चलनं संज्ञायां कन्] A short
petticoat worn by low women.
--निका Silken fringes.

चलित p. p. [चल्-क्त]
1 Shaken,
moved, stirred, agitated.
--2 Gone,
departed; एवमुक्त्वा स चलितः.
--3
Attained.
--4 Known, understood.
--5 Removed, displaced. (see चल्).
--तं
1 Shaking, moving.
--2 Going,
[]
walking.
--3 A kind of dance;
चलितं नाम नाट्यमंतरंण

चलुकः [चलुना मीयते कन् Tv.]
1
Water taken up in the hollowed
palm for rinsing the mouth.
--2 A
handful or mouthful (of water);
cf. चुलुक.

चलद्विषः The Kokila or Indian
cuckoo.

चालः [चल्-ण]
1 The thatch or
roof of a house.
--2 The blue jay.
--3 Being moveable.

चालनं [चल्-णिच् भावे ल्युट्]
1
Causing to move, shaking, wagging (as
a tail).
--2 Loosening.
--3 Muscular
action.
--4 Causing to pass through
a sieve, sifting.
--5 A sieve.
--नी A
sieve, strainer.

चालनीय a.
1 To be moved.
--2
To be loosened or shaken; also
चाल्य in the same sense.
